label: D1 after a reward while leaning to a2, early in the episode
explanation: Fires mostly at D1 (86% of mass) and never at GO. At D1 it needs the reward input on (prev_reward == 1 accounts for essentially all mass) and the agent leaning toward a2: 99% of mass is on trials whose choice is a2, and the D1 policy logit is in a moderate a2 band (choice -4.4..-1.5, 90% of mass). It is also limited to early episodes: trials 0-45, with almost nothing after trial 50, and it sits in a narrow value band (7.54-7.73). It mostly shows up when S2 is good, which fits the a2 preference. A weaker D2 component (14% of mass) comes in the same rewarded a2 regime. Using the observed upcoming choice instead (action == 2) gives a dev F1 of 0.59 against 0.66 for the recorded choice-logit version; neither uses future random outcomes. It does not fire at GO, after unrewarded trials, when the agent leans to a1, or late in the episode. Precision stays about 0.57 because many matching D1 steps stay silent, so this is a snapshot of an early-episode, rewarded, a2-leaning regime and not a clean rule. Magnitude was not checked in detail.
